q: In which town was Jesus raised as a child after returning from Egypt?
x: Joseph took Mary and Jesus to dwell in a city called Nazareth, fulfilling the prophecy: "He shall be called a Nazarene."

q: How many smooth stones did young David take from the brook when confronting Goliath?
x: David chose five smooth stones from the brook and put them in his shepherd's bag, trusting the LORD of Hosts for victory.

q: What was the first public miracle recorded that Jesus performed in the Gospel of John?
o: Healing the blind man at Siloam
Walking on the Sea of Galilee
Turning water into wine at Cana
Multiplying five loaves and two fish
x: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, manifesting His glory so that His disciples believed in Him.

q: Which prophet was fed by ravens with bread and flesh at the brook Cherith?
x: God commanded Elijah to hide by the brook Cherith, where ravens brought him bread and meat morning and evening.

q: On which road did Saul encounter the blinding light and voice of the risen Christ?
x: As Saul journeyed toward Damascus, a light from heaven shone round about him and Jesus called him into apostleship.

q: Who climbed a sycomore tree to see Jesus passing through Jericho?
x: Zacchaeus, a chief among the publicans who was little of stature, ran before and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see Jesus.

q: For how many pieces of silver did Joseph's brothers sell him to the Ishmeelites?
x: The brothers lifted Joseph up out of the pit and sold him for twenty pieces of silver to the merchants travelling to Egypt.

q: In the Parable of the Good Samaritan, who passed by on the other side before the Samaritan stopped?
o: A Roman soldier and a merchant
x: Both a priest and a Levite saw the wounded man and passed by on the other side before the compassionate Samaritan ministered to him.

q: Which king of Judah began to reign when he was only seven years old?
x: Joash (Jehoash) was seven years old when he began to reign in Jerusalem under the godly guidance of Jehoiada the priest.

q: Who was chosen by lot to replace Judas Iscariot among the twelve apostles?
x: They gave forth their lots between Joseph called Barsabas and Matthias; the lot fell upon Matthias and he was numbered with the eleven.

q: What did Samson use to slay a thousand Philistines at Lehi?
o: A new jawbone of an ass
x: Samson found a new jawbone of an ass, put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.

q: How many baskets of leftover fragments were taken up after Jesus fed the five thousand?
x: They did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.

q: Which queen risked her life by going in to King Ahasuerus unsummoned to save her people?
x: Esther said: "Fast ye for me... and so will I go in unto the king, which is not according to the law: and if I perish, I perish."

q: In Philippi, who was baptized after an earthquake opened the prison doors at midnight?
o: The Philippian jailer and his household
x: The trembling jailer cried, "Sirs, what must I do to be saved?" and he and all his were baptized straightway that same hour of the night.

q: How many days had Lazarus lain in the grave before Jesus cried, "Lazarus, come forth"?
x: Martha said, "Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days." Jesus showed He is the Resurrection and the Life.

q: What kind of wood was Noah commanded to use to build the ark?
x: God said to Noah: "Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch."

q: Which disciple came down out of the ship and walked on the water to go to Jesus?
x: Peter answered, "Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water." And Jesus said, "Come."

q: What fell from heaven to consume Elijah's sacrifice on Mount Carmel?
x: The fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.

q: On which island was the Apostle Paul shipwrecked while travelling as a prisoner to Rome?
x: When they were escaped, they knew that the island was called Melita (modern Malta), where Paul shook off a viper unhurt.

q: What gifts did the wise men from the east present to the young child Jesus?
x: They presented unto him gifts: gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

q: On which day of creation did God make the sun, moon and stars?
x: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also. And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth, And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and…

q: From what did the LORD God form man?
x: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

q: What was the name of the garden the LORD God planted eastward?
x: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.

q: Who was the firstborn son of Adam and Eve?
x: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD.

q: Who "walked with God: and he was not; for God took him"?
x: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.

q: Who lived 969 years, the longest life recorded in the Bible?
x: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.

q: For how many days and nights did rain fall upon the earth in the flood?
x: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

q: Upon which mountains did the ark rest?
x: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.

q: What did the dove bring back to Noah in her mouth?
x: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf plucked off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

q: What token of the covenant did God set in the cloud after the flood?
x: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

q: Where was the tower built when the LORD confounded the language of all the earth?
x: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.

q: From which city did Terah set out with Abram, 'to go into the land of Canaan'?
x: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.

q: What was the name of Abraham's wife before God changed it to Sarah?
x: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.

q: How old was Abraham when his son Isaac was born?
x: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.

q: What did Lot's wife become when she looked back from behind him?
x: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

q: What animal did God provide as an offering in the stead of Isaac?
x: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.

q: Who became the wife of Isaac?
x: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.

q: What did Jacob give Esau in exchange for his birthright?
x: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.

q: What did Jacob see in his dream at Bethel?
o: Seven fat kine and seven lean kine
A ladder set up on the earth reaching to heaven
x: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

q: How many years did Jacob serve Laban for Rachel the first time?
x: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.

q: What new name did God give Jacob after he wrestled until the breaking of the day?
x: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

q: What did Israel make for Joseph that showed he loved him more than his brethren?
x: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.

q: To which officer of Pharaoh was Joseph sold in Egypt?
x: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.

q: According to Joseph's interpretation of Pharaoh's dream, how many years of plenty would come?
x: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:

q: Which brother did Joseph take and bind before the eyes of the others in Egypt?
x: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.

q: In whose sack was Joseph's silver cup found?
x: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

q: In which land of Egypt did Israel dwell and grow and multiply?
x: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

q: Who was king of Salem and priest of the most high God, and blessed Abram?
x: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God. And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:

q: What relation was Lot to Abram?
x: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.

q: What were the names of the two sons born to Joseph in Egypt?
x: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house. And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

q: Who found the baby Moses in the ark of bulrushes?
x: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river's side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.

q: Whom did Moses take as his wife in Midian?
x: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.

q: At which mountain did Moses see the bush that burned but was not consumed?
x: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.

q: At the burning bush, what did God answer when Moses asked His name?
x: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.

q: Whom did the LORD appoint to speak for Moses because he was slow of speech?
x: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.

q: What did Aaron's rod become when he cast it down before Pharaoh?
x: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the LORD had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

q: What was the first plague upon Egypt?
o: The waters were turned to blood
x: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

q: What was the last plague upon Egypt?
x: And it came to pass, that at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.

q: What were the Israelites to put on the two side posts and upper door post at the Passover?
x: And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.

q: What did the house of Israel call the bread God gave them in the wilderness?
x: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.

q: Who held up Moses' hands so that Israel prevailed against Amalek?
x: But Moses' hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.

q: Which priest of Midian, Moses' father in law, advised him to appoint rulers to judge the people?
x: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt;

q: What did Aaron make from the people's golden earrings while Moses was on the mount?
x: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

q: How long was Moses in the mount with God when he received the law?
x: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.

q: How many men did Moses send to spy out the land of Canaan, one of every tribe?
x: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:

q: Which two of the spies rent their clothes and urged Israel to go into the land?
x: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:

q: What did Moses set upon a pole so that anyone bitten could look on it and live?
x: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.

q: Whose ass spoke to him when the angel of the LORD stood in the way?
x: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?

q: From which mountain did Moses view the promised land before he died?
x: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And the LORD showed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,

q: Who was full of the spirit of wisdom and led Israel after the death of Moses?
x: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.

q: Which two sons of Aaron offered strange fire before the LORD and died?
x: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.

q: Whose rebellion ended when the earth opened her mouth and swallowed the men that appertained to him?
x: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.

q: Which woman of Jericho hid the two spies sent by Joshua?
x: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot's house, named Rahab, and lodged there.

q: What did Rahab bind in her window as a sign for the spies?
x: Behold, when we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father's household, home unto thee.

q: How many times did Israel compass the city of Jericho on the seventh day?
x: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.

q: Which river did Israel cross on dry ground when they entered the promised land under Joshua?
x: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.

q: Who spoke to the LORD, and said "Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon"?
x: Then spake Joshua to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.

q: Who took of the accursed thing at Jericho, bringing defeat upon Israel at Ai?
x: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the accursed thing: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against the children of Israel.

q: Which prophetess judged Israel and dwelt under a palm tree?
x: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time. And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

q: Who slew Sisera by driving a nail of the tent into his temples?
x: Then Jael Heber's wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.

q: What did Gideon put on the floor to ask God for a sign?
x: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.

q: With how many men did the LORD save Israel from the Midianites under Gideon?
x: And the LORD said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.

q: What was Samson to be "unto God from the womb", so that no razor would come on his head?
x: For, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.

q: What did Samson find in the carcase of the lion he had slain?
o: A swarm of bees and honey
x: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.

q: Who enticed Samson to reveal the secret of his strength to the Philistines?
x: And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, Come up this once, for he hath showed me all his heart. Then the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and brought money in their hand.

q: The Philistines gathered to offer a great sacrifice to which god when Samson was brought out?
x: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their god, and to rejoice: for they said, Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.

q: Which judge vowed a vow to the LORD before going against the children of Ammon?
x: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,

q: Which left-handed deliverer slew Eglon king of Moab?
x: But when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.

q: With what did Shamgar slay six hundred Philistines?
x: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Israel.

q: From which land did Ruth come?
x: And they took them wives of the women of Moab; the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth: and they dwelled there about ten years.

q: To whom did Ruth say, "Whither thou goest, I will go"?
x: And Ruth said, Entreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

q: In whose field did Ruth glean after the reapers?
x: And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz, who was of the kindred of Elimelech.

q: Which king was the great-grandson of Ruth and Boaz?
x: And the women her neighbours gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.

q: Who was the mother of the prophet Samuel?
x: Wherefore it came to pass, when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived, that she bare a son, and called his name Samuel, saying, Because I have asked him of the LORD.

q: Before which priest did the child Samuel minister unto the LORD?
x: And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days; there was no open vision.

q: What were the names of the two wicked sons of Eli?
x: And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the LORD of hosts in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the LORD, were there.

q: Who was made the first king over Israel?
x: And all the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.

q: Of which tribe was King Saul?
x: And Saul answered and said, Am not I a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? and my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? wherefore then speakest thou so to me?

q: What was the name of David's father?
x: And the LORD said unto Samuel, How long wilt thou mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? fill thine horn with oil, and go, I will send thee to Jesse the Bethlehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons.

q: From which Philistine city did Goliath come?
x: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.

q: What instrument did David play to refresh Saul when the evil spirit came upon him?
x: And it came to pass, when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul, that David took an harp, and played with his hand: so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.

q: Which son of Saul loved David as his own soul?
x: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

q: Which daughter of Saul did David take to wife?
x: Wherefore David arose and went, he and his men, and slew of the Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full tale to the king, that he might be the king's son in law. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife.

q: Who was the wife of churlish Nabal?
x: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man was churlish and evil in his doings; and he was of the house of Caleb.

q: Where did Saul seek a woman that had a familiar spirit?
x: Then said Saul unto his servants, Seek me a woman that hath a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and inquire of her. And his servants said to him, Behold, there is a woman that hath a familiar spirit at Endor.

q: Whom did David have set in the forefront of the hottest battle?
x: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, and die.

q: Which prophet told David the parable of the poor man's one little ewe lamb?
x: And the LORD sent Nathan unto David. And he came unto him, and said unto him, There were two men in one city; the one rich, and the other poor.

q: Who was the mother of King Solomon?
x: And David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in unto her, and lay with her: and she bare a son, and he called his name Solomon: and the LORD loved him.

q: Which son of David was caught by his head in an oak while riding a mule?
x: And Absalom met the servants of David. And Absalom rode upon a mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth; and the mule that was under him went away.

q: Who built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem and finished it?
x: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.

q: Which queen came to prove Solomon with hard questions?
x: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to prove him with hard questions.

q: Over which king did the ten tribes depart to their tents, leaving him only the cities of Judah?
x: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents. But as for the…

q: Which daughter of the king of the Zidonians did Ahab take to wife?
x: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.

q: To which town did God send Elijah to be sustained by a widow woman?
x: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.

q: How many of Baal's prophets stood against Elijah on Mount Carmel?
x: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of the LORD; but Baal's prophets are four hundred and fifty men.

q: After the wind, the earthquake and the fire, how did the LORD come to Elijah at Horeb?
x: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.

q: Who asked for a double portion of Elijah's spirit?
x: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.

q: How was Elijah taken up into heaven?
x: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

q: How many times did Naaman dip himself in Jordan to be healed of leprosy?
x: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

q: Naaman was captain of the host of the king of which land?
x: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the LORD had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, but he was a leper.

q: Which servant of Elisha was struck with Naaman's leprosy for his greed?
x: But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him, Whence comest thou, Gehazi? And he said, Thy servant went no whither. And he said unto him, Went not mine heart with thee, when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive…

q: Which sick king was told "Set thine house in order" and then had fifteen years added to his life?
x: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live. Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto the LORD, saying, I beseech thee, O LORD, remember…

q: How old was Josiah when he began to reign?
x: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.

q: Which king of Babylon came against Jerusalem and besieged it in the days of Zedekiah?
